### model_description { #formulae.model_description.model_description }

```python
model_description.model_description(formula)
```

Interpret model formula and obtain a model description.

This function receives a string with a formula describing a statistical
model and returns an object of class `Model` that describes the
model interpreted from the formula.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**formula**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A string with a model description in formula language.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [An object of class `Model` with an internal description of the model.]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:
